# Adorbis Technology

> AI infrastructure company. NDA-first. DPIIT-recognized startup (DIPP52616). Operating since 2019. Two entities: Adorbis Technology Pvt Ltd (Hyderabad, India) and Adorbis LLC (Sheridan, Wyoming, USA). Wix Marketplace Partner and Shopify Partner.

We design custom AI models, automate workflows, deploy private LLM infrastructure, build AI-native eCommerce stores, and develop SaaS applications for businesses that prioritize data control and confidentiality.

## Capabilities

- [AI Model Training and Fine-Tuning](https://adorbistechnology.com/pages/model-training.html): Custom-trained Llama, Mistral, Qwen, DeepSeek models on proprietary data
- [AI Workflow Automation](https://adorbistechnology.com/pages/workflow-automation.html): n8n, LangGraph, Temporal orchestration on client infrastructure
- [Private LLM Deployment](https://adorbistechnology.com/pages/private-llms.html): On-premise and private-cloud LLM infrastructure with full audit trails
- [AI Infrastructure Setup](https://adorbistechnology.com/pages/ai-infrastructure.html): GPU clusters, vector databases, observability, guardrails
- [AI Software Enhancement](https://adorbistechnology.com/pages/ai-enhancement.html): Upgrade existing enterprise software (CRM, ERP, accounting) with AI plugins instead of replacing
- [eCommerce Development](https://adorbistechnology.com/pages/ecommerce.html): Wix and Shopify Partner. AI-native catalog, GEO/SEO, marketplace automation
- [SaaS Application Development](https://adorbistechnology.com/pages/saas.html): AI-native B2B and consumer SaaS, full-stack engineering

## Industries

[11 verticals covered](https://adorbistechnology.com/pages/industries.html): Finance and Banking, Retail and eCommerce, Transport and Logistics, Medical Research, Education Technology, Hospitals and Clinics, Schools and K-12, Chartered Accountants and CPAs, Architecture and Design Firms, Manufacturing Industries, Factories and Plant Operations.
